status: pre-registered before the test run; design data = the MOTION-327 test set (motion312-acceptance/v2-test-20261020) and its fallback re-run (v2-test-fallback-20261023)

baseline.note: same baseline as MOTION-323/327; conclusions not extrapolated to upstream 0942d18

method.base: MOTION-327 cartesian_v2 frozen options (846f0dc) with TOPP-RA timing

options.fallback_joint_rrt: if the Cartesian search returns no path, the rest of the same 2 s transport budget goes to the baseline joint RRT (same goals and seed)
options.route_branch_change: if the nearest goal in the baseline's goal order lies on another wrist branch sign(q2,q4,q6) than the start, the stage goes to the baseline joint RRT directly

method.design_evidence: motion312-acceptance/r20-diag-20261023 (right20 diagnosis, straight-line failure classes and the routing proxy on the 50 MOTION-327 test scenes)

test_set.purpose: independent: new docking offsets and new seeds, never run before
test_set.scene_model: as MOTION-327: container walls, ground, filler blocks and target boxes shifted by (dx, dy, 0) relative to the robot; conveyor unchanged
test_set.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(342).uniform(-0.05, 0.05, size=(25, 2, 2)), rounded to 0.1 mm; tasks = the 25 single-arm tasks of MOTION-327

decision_rules.same_as: MOTION-327 decision_rules, applied to each variant against joint_rrt
decision_rules.planning_time: paired median change of the transport stage time <= +10%; every search within 2 s (expected to fail; the time cost was accepted by the owner on 2026-10-23 and is reported, not waived)
decision_rules.success: success rate not lower than the baseline
decision_rules.quality: paired median extra box rotation on side tasks reduced by at least 30%; tool path/chord ratio not increased

tradeoff_report.purpose: choose between the two variants (owner decision after the run); report-only, no threshold
metrics: runs whose transport execution takes more than 2x / 3x the paired baseline, P90 and max of that ratio
runs with at least one wrist branch flip in the executed transport; min singularity margin
side and top extra rotation medians; paired side reduction
transports by tier (direct_line, rrt, joint_rrt_fallback, joint_rrt_routed)

hypotheses.cartesian_v21_toppra: success equal to the baseline; quality and duration as MOTION-327; long-detour tail remains
hypotheses.cartesian_v21r_toppra: success equal to the baseline; no >2x tail from routed stages; flips and extra rotation in routed stages as the baseline's
